title: HistCorp — Historical Corpora and Tools (fornsvenska / Fornsvenska textbanken)
notes: HistCorp is an open platform for historical corpora and tools, distributed via the Swedish CLARIN node; its Swedish section is built on Fornsvenska textbanken (machine-readable Old/Early Modern Swedish texts 1350-1758), all supplied as plain text (RQ fmt_detected: plain). Freely available; ATTRIBUTIONS lists the collection as cc_by. The 20 RQ texts (e.g. 'HistorCorp fornsvenska: Prosaiska kronikan (1450)' -> origin 'HistCorp fornsvenska: Prosaiska krönikan (1450)') are directly from this download bundle. Note: Sprakbanken Text Gothenburg's Korp 'all_hist' mode offers related searchable corpora; HistCorp is the canonical downloadable source. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Eva Pettersson (Uppsala University) & Beata Megyesi (Stockholm University), Swedish CLARIN
